decision: Use public benchmarks as bounded stress tests inside an intended-use evidence ladder. No public benchmark score can establish zero harm, local clinical efficacy, or deployment readiness.

syntheticSoftwareContractEvidence.boundary: Only the checked-in synthetic contracts and artifacts; completion of the full validation command is still required for a release commit.

physicianAuthoredDevelopmentReference.boundary: A signed single-clinician development reference would not be consensus or external validation.

clinicalPerformanceEstimated.reason: No untouched representative patient- and episode-independent sample exists.

clinicalEfficacyEstablished.reason: No prospective comparative clinical study or patient-outcome evidence exists.

clinicallyDeploymentReady.reason: Clinical reference, external validation, human factors, shadow mode, governance, and outcome gates remain incomplete.

zeroHarmEstablished.reason: Finite evaluation can discover and bound failure rates but cannot prove the absence of all harm across future users, settings, or distributions.

requiredEvidence: Register a new retrieval candidate and new untouched holdout; do not tune the rejected candidate on revealed labels.
